encode_numpy_array_to_proto: encode a numpy array into a storage_pb2.Data protobuf object for serialization to disk
encode_python_data_to_proto: encode Python lists, tuples, dicts, or scalars into storage_pb2.Data protobuf objects
decode_proto_to_python: decode a storage_pb2.Data protobuf back into numpy arrays, lists, tuples, or dicts
decode_datum_to_scalar_or_array: decode a single Datum protobuf into a numpy scalar or reshaped numpy array
encode_arbitrary_int_to_bytes: encode a Python integer into a signed big-endian byte string without losing precision
